# `loans.credito_pessoal.LoanDisbursed`

The loan is disbursed: the lump-sum principal is paid out and the closed-end French-system amortization schedule (quadro de amortização) is fixed at constitution (fin-math §4.1). The closed-end-asset analogue of term_deposit.DepositConstituted. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). Origination stays upstream ([ADR-PC-030](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-030-product-scope-and-boundary.md) / [ADR-PC-024](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-024-constitution-precondition-contract.md)) — the loan arrives already approved and priced.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | LoanId (Guid). |
| `principal_cents` | `long` | Disbursed capital (lump sum) as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1). |
| `tan_basis_points` | `int` | Annual nominal rate (TAN) in basis points, resolved from the rate sheet at constitution. |
| `rate_sheet_version_id` | `string` | The pinned rate-sheet version the TAN was resolved from. |
| `term_months` | `int` | Number of monthly installments the loan amortizes over. |
| `periodic_rate_basis_points` | `int` | The periodic (monthly) rate the schedule amortizes at, in basis points (TAN_bps / 12, the PT proportional-rate convention, fin-math §2.2). |
| `installment_amount_cents` | `long` | The level (constant) installment the borrower pays each period as integer EUR cents (P = C × r / (1 − (1 + r)^−n), fin-math §4.1). |
| `start_date` | `int` (`date`) | Disbursement date (schedule anchor) as days since epoch. |
| `first_installment_date` | `int` (`date`) | Due date of the first installment (start_date + one cadence) as days since epoch. |
| `finalidade` | `string` | The loan purpose/finalidade category (e.g. general, education, health) — selects the legal TAEG ceiling bucket (research/credito-pessoal/02 §2). Structural, NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `product_code` | `string` | The catalogue product code the rate sheet priced — the structural product identifier. NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| `disbursement_account` | `string` | An OPAQUE disbursement-account TOKEN — a REFERENCE the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/cleartext identifier ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). The account the lump sum was credited to. |
| `early_repayment_commission_bps` | `int` | The early-repayment commission the product charges, in basis points, PINNED at constitution ([ADR-PC-009](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-009-per-instance-version-pinning.md)). The capped comissão de reembolso antecipado a later early repayment charges resolves from this (fin-math §7.5). 0 ⇒ no commission. Additive with a default so pre-field records still decode (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3). |
